text: Now about the times and seasons, brothers (and sisters), we do not need to write to you⁺.
For you⁺ are fully aware that the Day of the Lord {Kyriou} will come like a thief in the night.
While people are saying, “Peace and security, destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
But you⁺, brothers (and sisters), are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you⁺ like a thief.
For you⁺ are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.
For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love {agapēs}, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
For God {Theos} has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord {Kyriou} Jesus (YHWH saves) Christ (the Anointed One).
He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.
Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you⁺ are already doing.
But we ask you⁺, brothers (and sisters), to acknowledge those who work diligently among you⁺, who care for you⁺ in the Lord {Kyriō} and who admonish you⁺.
In love {agapē}, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
And we urge you⁺, brothers (and sisters), to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
Rejoice at all times.
Pray without ceasing.
Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s {Theou} will for you⁺ in Christ (the Anointed One) Jesus (YHWH saves).
Do not extinguish the Spirit {Pneuma}.
Do not treat prophecies with contempt,
but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.
Abstain from every form of evil.

Now may the God {Theos} of peace Himself sanctify you⁺ completely, and may your⁺ entire spirit {pneuma}, soul {psychē}, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord {Kyriou} Jesus (YHWH saves) Christ (the Anointed One).
The One who calls you⁺ is faithful, and He will do it.
Brothers, pray for us as well.
Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
I charge you⁺ before the Lord {Kyrion} to have this letter {epistolēn} read to all the brothers (and sisters).
The grace of our Lord {Kyriou} Jesus (YHWH saves) Christ (the Anointed One) be with you⁺ [Amen.].
